description: This file defines an interface for rendering different form and widget fields in OFBiz's widget framework. It contains method signatures for rendering various form components like text fields, date/time fields, dropdowns, checkboxes, radios, submit/reset fields, hidden fields, form wrappers, headers, rows, and special find and file fields. The interface acts as a contract for implementing the actual rendering logic in Java classes.

methods.name: renderDisplayField
methods.description: Renders a display-only form field using the provided writer and context.

methods.name: renderIgnoredField
methods.description: Renders a field intended to be ignored or hidden.

methods.name: renderFieldTitle
methods.description: Renders the title of a form field.

methods.name: renderSingleFormFieldTitle
methods.description: Renders title for a single form field.

methods.name: renderFormOpen
methods.description: Outputs the opening HTML for a form.

methods.name: renderFormClose
methods.description: Outputs the closing HTML for a form.

methods.name: renderMultiFormClose
methods.description: Outputs HTML to close multi-part forms.

methods.name: renderFormatListWrapperOpen
methods.description: Opens a wrapper for a list format of the form.

methods.name: renderFormatHeaderRowCellOpen
methods.description: Opens a cell in a header row, with span.

methods.name: renderFormatHeaderRowFormCellOpen
methods.description: Opens a form cell in header row.

methods.name: renderFormatHeaderRowFormCellClose
methods.description: Closes form cell in header row.

methods.name: renderFormatHeaderRowFormCellTitleSeparator
methods.description: Renders a separator for form cell title in header row.

methods.name: renderFormatItemRowCellOpen
methods.description: Opens a cell in an item row.

methods.name: renderFormatItemRowCellClose
methods.description: Closes a cell in an item row.

methods.name: renderFormatItemRowFormCellOpen
methods.description: Opens a form cell in an item row.

methods.name: renderFormatItemRowFormCellClose
methods.description: Closes a form cell in item row.

methods.name: renderFormatFieldRowTitleCellOpen
methods.description: Opens a title cell in a field row.

methods.name: renderFormatFieldRowWidgetCellOpen
methods.description: Opens a widget cell in a field row.

methods.name: renderTextFindField
methods.description: Renders a text find field for search.

methods.name: renderDateRangePickerField
methods.description: Renders a date range picker field.

methods.name: renderImageField
methods.description: Renders an image upload or display field.

methods.name: renderContainerFindField
methods.description: Renders a container for find/search fields.

methods.name: renderFieldGroupOpen
methods.description: Starts a group of form fields.

methods.name: renderFieldGroupClose
methods.description: Ends a group of form fields.

methods.name: renderEmptyFormDataMessage
methods.description: Displays a message indicating no form data available.
